attributes_meta.note: Preferred-foot resolution. Side is derived from the starting-XI role, not from this resolver. The licensed API does not provide foot; Sportmonks is used when enabled; Wikipedia is the last resort and only explicit statements are accepted. Unknown is a valid state.

availability_meta.note: Curated official AFC team news is primary. Provider injuries are optional and are not team news. Unknown stays unknown.

coverage.note: Current-season squad and per-competition statistics from API-Football. Roles come from the starting-XI formation grid; starts, substitute appearances and on-pitch minutes are reconstructed from lineups and substitution events. The official AFC men's team page is the canonical roster inclusion, section, order and loan-section source; API-Football supplies statistics and identity. API rows not on the official list are not squad players and are excluded from these counts; they are retained only for the player index and existing links. Missing data is labelled unavailable or partial and is never filled with zeroes. Player photographs are not published.
